scope: One opt-in indexed URL query source and warning-level org-scope owner advice on the existing impression profile.

primary_source_chain.does_not_support: Other hosts/routes, account-issued ID grammar or receiver acceptance.

primary_source_chain.supports: External IDs can be supplied as click/impression URL parameters. The table names xid[][scope_type] and scope_id and links the common External IDs contract. Complete examples use explicit index0/1.
primary_source_chain.does_not_support: Literal empty-index row pairing, index limits, contiguity or identifier/type closure.

primary_source_chain.supports: Cross-game IDs require org scope and an Organization ID supplied as scope_id. Applied only as same-row advice after binding through the URL parameter guide.
primary_source_chain.does_not_support: Impression auth, native event body requirements, guaranteed rejection, account validity or a new identity grammar.

source_receipt.kind: Opened official pages through web text extraction, not original downloaded bytes. Direct .md fetches returned HTTP 403.

core_contract.key_prefix: Required nonempty literal prefix without brackets; illegal on legacy sources.
core_contract.index: Nonempty ASCII digits preserved lexically, including 0, 00, gaps and arbitrarily large spellings. No integer conversion, bound or contiguity.
core_contract.leaf: One nonempty decoded field name without brackets. Other layouts are outside this source.
core_contract.carrier: URL query only; bare, blank and duplicate pairs retained with normal one-pass name/value decoding. No form fallback, fragments, nested query decoding or second percent decoding.
core_contract.conditions: Existing scope-local params/rules/conditions. No cross-row or global borrowing. First/last/global filters are rejected; first_index remains default zero.
core_contract.targets: Existing pair spans and original decoded physical keys are retained internally. A missing field anchors only the first actual pair in its row, never a min/max range across interleaved records. Complete HTTP handling retains its existing normalized-target clearing policy.
core_contract.legacy: Legacy extraction, semicolon groups, path items and ordinary indexed_param_groups are unchanged. Absent key_prefix is not serialized.

params.name: scope_type
params.description: Row-local discriminator only. Existing URL-family checks retain the published scope options. Mixed, blank and macro discriminator observations do not activate the org dependency.

params.name: scope_id
params.description: The linked common External IDs guide asks for scope_type=org and the Organization ID as scope_id for cross-game sharing. This is a local advisory for explicit numeric indexed URL rows, with no identifier grammar or receiver rejection claim.
params.fix_hint: Supply the organization ID in scope_id for this same indexed External ID.

retained_constraints: Existing six URL field contracts, host/path selection, macro handling and source severities are unchanged.
test_scope: Eight generic mechanism groups cover indexes, local guards, bare/blank/duplicate/macro fields, once-only decoding, fragments/nested text, interleaved original spans, HTTP URL-only behavior and invalid schema options.
Four Gamesight source groups cover59new golden cases; three original impression tests remain.
A core unit test verifies absent key_prefix does not change legacy serialized scope metadata.
remaining_gaps: Literal xid[] pairing is not established by the table notation and remains deferred.
No id/type requiredness, opaque ID grammar, hashing correctness, scope_id account validity or other per-index dependency is inferred.
Missing/empty scope_id advice is activated only when all observed scope_type values in that lexical row are literal org. Conflicting, blank, bare or macro observations defer it.
Custom domains, cost amount/currency/window semantics, tracker state, account ownership and receiver acceptance remain external.
Existing core VAST unknown-bracket and ignored-fragment diagnostics are preserved in fixture expectations.

validation.independent_review: Core/schema and Gamesight source boundaries reviewed without findings. Exact production hashes approved in the QA ledger.
validation.legacy_diagnostics: Original Gamesight tests and the complete golden corpus pass. Existing core fragment and VAST bracket findings are preserved in new expectations.

shared_review_hashes: Root owns the independently approved shared manifest.rs/schema pin transitions. This author updates only the Gamesight audit entry.
